reasonSuffix.target: The final response is as follows:

parameterConfirmation.target: This is a confirm value result. The response needs to confirm the given value with the user.

parameterNeedsValue.target: This is a request value result. The response needs to request a value from the user.

successSelective.target: This is a successful result with many parameter values, so selecting information from the response manifest may be necessary.

failure.target: The tool has produced an error.

successAll.target: This is a successful result where most or all information from the response manifest is necessary.

actionConfirmation.target: This is a confirm action result. The response needs to confirm the given action with the user.

successEmpty.target: This is a successful result with an empty response manifest. So tool name and description will be used to form the response.

successSearch.target: This is a successful result from the search tool. Both query and response manifest can be used to form the response.

toolDisambiguation.target: This result contains multiple tools, so names of all tools will be used to form the response.

parameterDisambiguation.target: This result is a simple case of value disambiguation.
